title: Thutmose IV's Dream Stela

tellings.quote: during his reign, he erected something called the dream stella. And it was him talking about how when he was a young kid before he became Pharaoh, he went and slept under um the shade of the Sphinx and the Sphinx visited him in a dream

plain: The ancient Egyptian pharaoh Thutmose IV set up a carved stone slab called the Dream Stela during his reign. On it he tells how, as a boy before he became king, he fell asleep in the shade of the Sphinx at Giza, and the Sphinx came to him in a dream. The researcher Luke Caverns tells this from the stone's own story, as a sign of how the Egyptians themselves thought of the Sphinx.
